source: data/arctic-ch2-yield-audit-r1 verdicts and evidence bundles (chapter 2 run chapter2-e8d4cad-r1)
north_star: Can a strong scientist who cannot see the paper state what the task asks for, name the kind of answer it wants, and resolve every referent from the displayed text alone? The scientist is not expected to know the measured value.
why_iteration: These rows are the chapter 2 confirmed false fails and their control siblings. Contract v4 corrections SG-1 to SG-3 were derived from them, so the fixture rule forbids them in the held-out slice. They measure whether the deleted guessability clause is gone and whether the fail side still holds.
release_rule: No must_fail row may pass the composed gate decision, and at least 80 percent of must_pass rows must pass it. Every must_fail verdict must carry the evidence its code requires: an unresolved phrase copied from the displayed text, or two competing readings.
blocking_note: No judge prompt ships without a live calibration run on the configured standalone_verifier model. That run is paid, needs captain approval, and is run by the integration crew through the calibrate-standalone harness that the gates slice builds. Two independent human labelers must confirm every row before this slice gates production.
